description: The temporary in-process Node hot mutex for the repo state (events + claims merged) and for porting events. Fast path is link/unlink of a record file; a dead holder is removed only while holding a kernel lock, so two reclaimers can never both unlink. Ends when the store use-cases move to Rust and the hot mutex becomes a kernel lock.

state.fgosDir: the main checkout's .fgos, resolved once per process before the lock, never inside it

porting-events.fgosDir: the .fgos the porting store writes to

record.encoding: one JSON object, UTF-8, written to a temp file and published with link(); never partially visible

fields.startTime: process start time as process-identity reports it; null where the platform has none
fields.pidNs: string, present only where the holder could read it

acquire.fastPath: write record to a temp file, link() it to recordPath; EEXIST means held
acquire.reentry: the process already holds this resource (depth > 0) -> throw hot-lock-reentry at once, never wait

release: revoke the stateTx, then unlink recordPath; the holder only unlinks a record it published

reclaim.when: recordPath exists and judge(record) == dead; alive and unknown are never reclaimed
steps: read recordPath; unreadable or unparseable -> never reclaim, report lock-record-unreadable
take the kernel lock reclaimLockPath (holder-lock mutex, try once; held -> treat the hot lock as held)
re-read recordPath and compare bytes with the first read; different or gone -> release the kernel lock and retry the fast path
release the kernel lock, retry the fast path
reclaim.judge: packages/process/contracts/process-facts.judge.v1.json, the same verdict as every other holder

criticalSection.callback: synchronous; every write goes through stateTx
criticalSection.stateTx: revoked at release; a write through a revoked stateTx throws state-tx-revoked
criticalSection.noSubprocess: node:child_process spawn, spawnSync, exec, execSync, execFile, execFileSync and fork are wrapped once when the hot-lock module loads, followed by module.syncBuiltinESMExports() so named imports see the wrapper; a call while the depth is above 0 throws exec-under-hot-lock
criticalSection.noOtherLock: no other lock is waited for inside the critical section

errors.exec-under-hot-lock: a subprocess was started while this process holds a hot lock
errors.hot-lock-reentry: the process asked for a hot lock it already holds
errors.hot-lock-timeout: a live holder kept the hot lock past waitMs
errors.lock-record-unreadable: the record exists but cannot be read or parsed; a person confirms and runs fgos lock fence
errors.state-tx-revoked: a write went through a stateTx after its lock was released
